notes.title: Join our pre-release Q&A and playthrough
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41284372/85272afc253de00a94a0a004a275d7e78c2bd582.gif

To celebrate Wilderplace's launch, I will be livestreaming a few sections of the game, providing commentary, and answering questions from Twitch chat. The audio programmer and composer Micah Fitch and level designer Tom Lubanovic will also be on the mic! If you have questions about how we made Wilderplace, this is the time to ask. Join us starting at 5:30 PM on Thursday September 8th at https://www.twitch.tv/samanpwbb.

See you there!
- Saman
